additionalProperties.description: The Cloud Run settings of one app.

billing.description: How Cloud Run bills the app's services. request bills by the request and takes the CPU away once a response ends, so work after it, such as after(), waitUntil, a background page refresh or a tag purge, may stall until the next request or never run. instance bills the instance for its whole life, up to 15 minutes idle after the last request, and an idle instances.min instance in full. Left off, instance for a Next app or a container, and request for every other app.

network.description: Send the app's traffic to private addresses over the network named by option network, as an app bound to a postgres or kv is. Left off, only an app bound to one does.

additionalProperties.title: AppOptions

apps.description: Cloud Run settings for each app, keyed by the app's name.

allOf.description: A VPC network of the project and its subnetwork in the region.

network.description: The name of the VPC network, which must be in the project deployed into.

subnetwork.description: The name of the network's subnetwork in the region: the apps' Direct VPC egress leaves from it.

allOf.title: NetworkOptions

network.description: A VPC network of the project, and its subnetwork in the region, that this project's apps, kv stores and databases join instead of the tier's own network. Its owner makes the service connection policies Cloud SQL and Memorystore connect through, and ocel changes nothing on it.

ownDatabase.description: Keep this project's values, runs and tag records in a Firestore database of its own, which no other project's apps can reach. Left off, they are kept in the one database every project of the tier shares. Fixed by the project's first deploy or value.

project.description: The Google Cloud project to deploy into. Left off, from GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, CLOUDSDK_CORE_PROJECT or gcloud config.

region.description: The region to deploy into, such as us-central1, never a zone such as us-central1-f.
